== December 15, 2005 ==
* Fixed [[Sacrifice|sacrifice skills]] so that a [[player]] who sacrifices all of his remaining [[Health]] will [[Death|die]].
: ''Previously a [[bug]] allowed the player to stay alive if he had positive [[Health regeneration]] when he sacrificed all of his remaining Health.''

== Pre-release ==
During early development, the damage dealt by this skill was equal to the amount of health sacrificed, as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
